simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֹקֶף (H5363) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נֹקֶף (nôqeph) means a threshing (of olives) First listed occurrence: Isa 17 6.

definitions.full: H5363. noqeph נֹ֫קֶף noun [masculine] striking off ; — only construct כְּנֹקֶף זַיִת as (at) the striking of olive-trees Isa 17:6 ; 24:13 (simile of fewness of people after ׳י 's judgment).
